name: VEFaaS Sandbox
description: Sandbox backend powered by VEFaaS cloud sandbox applications and All-in-One HTTP shell/file APIs.

mode.label: Mode
mode.help: Workspace mode. The VEFaaS backend currently supports remote canonical workspaces.

functionId.label: Function ID
functionId.help: Optional VEFaaS sandbox application id. If omitted, the plugin creates or reuses functionName.

region.label: Region
region.help: Optional VEFaaS region used by the VEFaaS control plane.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.help: Optional VEFaaS control-plane endpoint used by the VEFaaS control plane.

image.label: Image
image.help: Sandbox image that contains opencode and the required runtime tools.

remoteWorkspaceDir.label: Remote Workspace Dir
remoteWorkspaceDir.help: Primary writable workspace inside the VEFaaS sandbox.

remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.label: Remote Agent Dir
remoteAgentWorkspaceDir.help: Agent workspace mirror path when workspaceAccess is read-only.

ttlSeconds.label: TTL Seconds
ttlSeconds.help: Requested sandbox lifetime before provider-side cleanup.

timeoutSeconds.label: Command Timeout Seconds
timeoutSeconds.help: Timeout for VEFaaS SDK and remote command operations.

resources.label: Resources
resources.help: Optional CPU, memory, and GPU request used by the VEFaaS control plane.

network.label: Network
network.help: Optional network placement and egress policy used by the VEFaaS control plane.

functionName.label: Function Name
functionName.help: VEFaaS sandbox application name to create or reuse when functionId is not set.

imageCommand.label: Image Command
imageCommand.help: Container command used by the VEFaaS sandbox instance.

port.label: Port
port.help: HTTP port exposed by the All-in-One sandbox image.

access.label: Access
access.help: HTTP route for All-in-One shell/file APIs, plus optional auth headers.

env.label: Environment
env.help: Additional VEFaaS sandbox instance environment variable overrides.

accessKeyId.label: Access Key ID
accessKeyId.help: Optional VEFaaS control-plane access key or SecretRef. Defaults to VOLCSTACK_ACCESS_KEY_ID, VOLCSTACK_ACCESS_KEY, VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY, or VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

secretAccessKey.label: Secret Access Key
secretAccessKey.help: Optional VEFaaS control-plane secret key or SecretRef. Defaults to VOLCSTACK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, VOLCSTACK_SECRET_KEY, VOLCENGINE_SECRET_KEY, or VOLCENGINE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

sessionToken.label: Session Token
sessionToken.help: Optional VEFaaS control-plane session token or SecretRef.
